_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/triggers/test_attack_enchanted_player_or_planeswalker.py. Never part of a deck list. `t_tenuous_truce` is Tenuous Truce's third sentence, both halves, each its own ability that sacrifices the Aura; `t_truce_lookout` is the per-creature `attacks` form of the same `defending` value, gaining 1 life per creature so a count can be read off a life total.

cards.name: Test Tenuous Truce
cards.oracle_text:
Enchant opponent
When you attack enchanted opponent or a planeswalker they control or when they attack you or a planeswalker you control, sacrifice this Aura.

When they attack you or a planeswalker you control, sacrifice this Aura.
